LESSON: GOOD CITIZENSHIP IN SCHOOL

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Good Citizenship in School
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

Welcome to this lesson on Good Citizenship in School. In Kenyan schools, learners explore this topic to understand how it connects to daily life in our communities. A key question we explore is: Citizenship and Governance in Kenya

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES AND VALUES

Core Competencies:
Citizenship: Learners role-play qualities of a good citizen in school

Values:

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: Learners develop harmonious coexistence as they discuss how to become a good citizen in school

Links to other Learning Areas:

and share the essays in class.
